user.title: Set up Zone Presence Detection
user.description: Zone presence detection for radar sensors with position data (e.g. HLK-LD2450 via ESPHome). Draw rooms and zones afterwards in the card or the sidebar panel.

data_description.panel_title: Empty = default title (“Präsenz-Zonen” on a German Home Assistant, otherwise “Zone Presence”).

sensor_device.title: Select sensor
sensor_device.description: Optionally select the device (e.g. your ESPHome LD2450). Target and presence entities are then suggested automatically.

sensor_entities.title: Assign entities
sensor_entities.description: x and y of target 1 are required. More targets and the presence sensor are optional. While the presence sensor is clear, all targets of this sensor are ignored.

error.pair_incomplete: Please provide x and y together.
error.same_entity: x and y must not be the same entity.
error.duplicate_entity: This entity is already used by another target.
error.required_xy: x and y of target 1 are required.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits or empty.

add_sensor.title: Add sensor
add_sensor.description: Optionally select the device to get the entities suggested. Placement and room are set in the card afterwards.

sensor_entities.title: Assign entities
sensor_entities.description: x and y of target 1 are required. More targets and the presence sensor are optional.

remove_sensor.title: Remove sensor
remove_sensor.description: The sensor and its learned ghost model are removed. Rooms and zones are kept.

settings.title: Algorithms & timings
settings.description: All values apply to the card and the sensors alike.

data.cal_max_spread: Auto alignment: max. spread of measurements

data_description.off_delay: How long a zone stays occupied after the last person left. Can be overridden per zone in the card.
data_description.confirm_time: New stationary detections must persist this long before they count as a person. Moving persons or persons seen by two sensors count earlier.
data_description.stuck_timeout: If a target does not change at all for this long, it is considered frozen (ESPHome hang) and ignored.
data_description.still_delay: A person staying inside the radius this long is considered sitting/lying.
data_description.still_radius: Movements inside this radius are strongly damped in sitting/lying mode.
data_description.tau_move: Smoothing time constant while walking. Smaller = more direct.
data_description.tau_still: Smoothing time constant while sitting/lying. Larger = calmer.
data_description.zone_exit_margin: A person only leaves a zone once this far outside.
data_description.still_exit_margin: Larger margin for sitting/lying persons – prevents drifting out of the zone.
data_description.merge_distance: Targets of different sensors within this distance count as one person.
data_description.wall_tolerance: Slightly outside the room is snapped to the wall, further outside is rejected.
data_description.max_speed: Faster jumps start a new target (slot switch/reflection).
data_description.ghost_filter: Scores every detection (age, travel, second sensor, learned ghost map). It can only reject persons, never create them.
data_description.ghost_strength: Higher = ghost areas are treated more strictly.
data_description.learning_speed: How fast the model keeps learning during normal operation.
data_description.memory_days: After this time, knowledge learned during operation is half as strong. The learning calibration does not decay.
data_description.cal_max_spread: During alignment, sensors whose measurement is further away from the mean are ignored (different target).

data_description.panel_title: Empty = default title (“Präsenz-Zonen” on a German Home Assistant, otherwise “Zone Presence”).

editing.name: Editing in card and panel
editing.description:
**The PIN is only active if the field contains an entry** (4 digits). Empty = no PIN.

⚠️ If **“Allow editing for non-administrators”** is checked, this PIN is the only thing that protects against unwanted changes. A PIN is strongly recommended with this option.

data_description.allow_user_edit: Unchecked, only administrators can change rooms, zones, sensors and calibration. Checked, all users can – then be sure to set a PIN.

start_learning_calibration.name: Start learning calibration
start_learning_calibration.description: Starts the ghost filter learning calibration right away. Rooms should be empty meanwhile.

abort_learning_calibration.name: Abort learning calibration
abort_learning_calibration.description: Aborts a running learning calibration without applying anything.

schedule_learning_calibration.name: Schedule learning calibration
schedule_learning_calibration.description: Schedules the learning calibration once for the next given time.

reset_learning_model.name: Reset learning model
reset_learning_model.description: Deletes everything learned (calibration and continuous learning).

import_legacy.name: Import previous package setup
import_legacy.description: Imports rooms, zones and sensor calibration from the input_text helpers of the earlier YAML/package setup.

cal_prefix.name: Calibration helper prefix
cal_prefix.description: e.g. input_text.zonen_cal_ (+ lowercase label, e.g. s1)

max_zones.name: Number of zone helpers
max_zones.description: How many zone helpers are read.

max_rooms.name: Number of room helpers
max_rooms.description: How many room helpers are read.

positions.name: Sensor positions
positions.description: Positions per sensor label if the calibration has none, e.g. {"S1": {"pos": [2.25, 0], "rot": 0}}.
